title: Session naming — simpler copy and saved sessions

steps.headline: 1. Less text around the naming model.
steps.changed: Shortened the default-model label and removed the repeated naming reassurance. Details remain under the information button.
steps.notice: The original styling stays as approved; your withdrawn first note has not been applied. Basic default and fixed review timing are unchanged.
steps.risk: This remains a simulated preview, not connected title generation.

steps.headline: 2. Rename saved sessions without reopening them.
steps.changed: Each saved session has a visible Rename action using the same dialog as an active session.
steps.notice: The action does not require hovering or opening the conversation. Saving a name protects it from automatic naming.
steps.risk: The visible action adds a line to each saved-session card.

steps.headline: 3. The rename dialog fits a phone-sized screen.
steps.changed: The saved-session rename action and dialog remain visible at phone width.
steps.notice: The name field, Cancel, and Save name fit without horizontal scrolling.
steps.risk: This checks the desktop remote layout at phone width. Android-local model execution is a separate backend task.

steps.headline: 4. Return a manually named session to automatic naming.
steps.changed: A manually named session offers Use automatic name. It restores the existing automatic name and removes your override.
steps.notice: The global mode stays unchanged. Off still stops automatic generation; manually chosen names otherwise remain protected.
steps.risk: Save, reopen, and restore were checked in the simulated preview; durable storage and sync still need implementation.
